evidence: The typed model reverses the earlier conclusion.

external_references.name: The phenotype dilution result was model-limited, not graph-limited

observation: The earlier conclusion that phenotype edges dilute the GNN came from a homogeneous encoder and a collapsing decoder. With relation-typed convolutions and a working decoder, core plus disease phenotype became the best graph at 5 and 10 seeds, and the full phenotype stayed close to core rather than far below it.
subject: F-127
title: The phenotype dilution result was model-limited, not graph-limited
